title: [CQ-C09] Documentation replacement recipe
description:
Objective: Implement one configured docs-only unique literal replacement with exact input/source/postpatch scope.

Deliverable: Documentation replacement recipe. This is task C09 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): C08.
definitionOfDone: Original hash and unique old text must match.
Required checks and allowed paths are supplied.
Extra edits, changed inputs or recipe mismatch refuse/fall back.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Implement docsLiteralReplace.ts, pure plus bounded read-only Git, as the single C08 recipe kind 'docs-literal-replace', version 1. Error handling: every function returns a typed refusal reason and never throws. Git, IO, timeout and decode failures all map to an unavailable reason.
(a) validateDefinition(def): allowedPaths is a non-empty list of normalized repo-relative prefixes (normalizeAffectedFile). requiredChecks is non-empty, validated through validateExecutionContract({requiredChecks}).
(b) validateInputs(inputs, def): exact keys {path, originalSha256, oldText, newText}. path is normalized, *.md, not under .moe/, and equal to or under an allowedPaths prefix. originalSha256 is 64 lowercase hex. oldText is 1-2000 chars, newText 0-2000 chars, neither contains NUL, and newText !== oldText.
(c) inputsDigest: sha256 of canonical JSON [kind, version, path, originalSha256, oldText, newText].
(d) assessSource(projectRoot, commit, inputs): REUSE readRepositorySource with one read query, raising maxFileBytes within validateSourceRequest's bounds. Require status 'served', mode 100644 and sha256(Buffer.from(content,'utf8')) === originalSha256. The decoder is fatal UTF-8 with the BOM kept, so the round trip is byte-exact. Count occurrences with indexOf(old, i+1) so overlapping repeats count. Return {ok, commit, oid, expectedSha256}.
(e) instantiate(inputs, def, assessment): a deterministic ordinary plan. It is one step whose description JSON-quotes oldText and newText and states the expected post-patch sha256 and 'change nothing else'. It has affectedFiles [path] and an executionContract carrying intendedBehavior, acceptanceCriteria, approvedScope, sourceAssumptions (commit, oid, sha256), checkRefs and requiredChecks from the definition. It must fit MAX_STEP_DESCRIPTION_CHARS; refuse rather than truncate.
(f) assessPostpatch(projectRoot, {baseCommit, postCommit}, inputs, expectedSha256): run openProjectGit and diff-tree -r -z --no-renames --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --raw base post with a bounded maxBuffer. Excluding only the task's own board path .moe/tasks/<taskId>.json, the changed set must be exactly [path]. Then read path at post through readRepositorySource and require sha256 === expectedSha256. No writes, no shell, no filesystem fallback.

Wire the kind into C08's framework with the smallest edit. Register it in C08's recipe-kind registry and hook assessPostpatch into C08's post-patch or eligibility call site. Before editing, run moe.declare_files on that landed C08 file; it does not exist at plan time, so it cannot be listed here. Ineligibility, a changed inputs digest and a recipe mismatch must return C08's concrete ordinary-planning fallback with these reason codes; extra edits must refuse. Add one test proving the registered kind is reachable through C08's entry point. If C08 landed no post-patch call site, do NOT invent a second authority. Call moe.report_blocked naming task-f12b03e83a1a491494a08e42c7a58504 and the missing hook. Keep the whole diff within 400 net lines and 3 files.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: I proposed the split to the C08 architect (architect-e4b7eee0, msg-af90dfdb) and had no reply when this plan was submitted. C08 owns the definition storage and protection, the internal-identity instantiation through submit_plan validation (CONTROL, SPEED and TURBO), and the fallback. C09 owns one kind, in new files. I rejected a hand-rolled blob reader: readRepositorySource (C02) already does bounded, committed-only, UTF-8-strict reads that refuse symlinks and submodules. I also rejected worktree reads, because the shared checkout is dirty. And I rejected a complete_task file-list check, because TOOL-tier attribution can land files the worker never reported. The post-patch check therefore diffs commits.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Reusable pieces:
- context/repositorySource.ts readRepositorySource(projectRoot, commit, queries, {limits}).
- util/cachedPlanPaths.ts openProjectGit and runGit: read-only env, budgeted.
- state/validators.ts validateExecutionContract, for requiredChecks.
- util/affectedFiles.ts normalizeAffectedFile.
- delivery/requiredChecks.ts, which shows the never-trust-candidate pattern.
submit_plan is blocking:true and runs Git outside the mutex. claim_next_task holds the mutex, so no Git may run synchronously there.
planningNotes.risks: C08 was unplanned at submit time, so every name here is assumed. Adapt them to the landed C08. The wrapper's completion commit includes the BOARD path .moe/tasks/<id>.json, so exclude only that path. Other tasks' commits interleave on the shared branch, so always diff the exact base and post commits, never a range. The size cap is 400 net lines.
